title: Consulting Engineer
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 

What you’ll do at Jamf:

 

The Consulting Engineer's (CE) primary role is to partner within Sales and other departments to achieve sales and revenue goals, serving as technical authority and escalation resource for complex opportunities. This role blends deep Apple ecosystem expertise with advanced security knowledge across endpoint protection, identity management, and network security, enabling you to design and deliver integrated enterprise solutions that drive innovation and support our customers beyond traditional device management. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams, as well as industry partners, to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions for enterprise environments.

 

This position is only available for employees located in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France. We are only able to accept applications for those based in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France and have sponsorship to live and work in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France #Li-Remote

 

What you can expect to do in this role:

 

  • Perform all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and vision of the organization
  • Provide technical consultation and technical escalation for Sales and other departments
  • Serve as technical escalation resource for Sales Engineers on complex, strategic opportunities requiring advanced architecture expertise or executive engagement
  • Continuously update expertise and demonstrate deep understanding of subject matter specific to role assignment, including but not limited to:
    • Architecture of Jamf's comprehensive platform solutions: Jamf for Mac, Jamf for Mobile, Jamf for K-12, and Jamf for Small Business
    • Architecture of Android device management and security solutions
    • Architecture of identity management solutions leveraging Platform SSO and enterprise directory integration
    • Architecture of enterprise security infrastructure (SIEM, SOAR, IAM platforms)
    • Architecture of Apple-centric zero-trust network frameworks such as Managed Device Attestation and WireGuard
    • Architecture of cross-platform security frameworks for enterprise environments
    • Architecture of Apple and Android-centric security frameworks for enterprise environments
    • Understanding of common and emerging threat vectors and risks specific to Apple and Android enterprise environments
    • Architecture of advanced Jamf configurations including automation frameworks and API integrations
    • Custom workflows and automation for large-scale enterprise deployments
  • Lead response to complex RFPs requiring comprehensive Apple enterprise expertise
  • Deliver technical presentations and executive workshops for enterprise prospects and customers
  • Collaborate with Sales, Professional Services, and Product teams to architect custom Apple enterprise solutions spanning management, endpoint security, and network security
  • Build and maintain strategic partner relationships with complementary solution providers (Apple, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Okta)
  • Develop and deliver internal training and knowledge transfer on Apple enterprise best practices and emerging capabilities
  • Create reusable implementation templates, automation tools, and methodologies for Apple enterprise deployments
  • Serve as an escalation point for Sales, Marketing, and Product teams on Apple enterprise matters
  • Represent Jamf as an Apple enterprise expert at industry events, conferences, and community forums
  • Drive innovation initiatives to address gaps in current solutions or where no solution exists
  • Contribute to product roadmap through field feedback and customer requirements
  • Active participation in professional development opportunities and industry training
  • Understand cross-platform integration scenarios and coexistence strategies in enterprise environments
  • Special projects assigned by management

 

What are we looking for:

 

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Apple device management, endpoint and/or network security (Required)
  • Experience working in consultative sales, pre-sales engineering, or technical sales support roles (Required)
  • Advanced knowledge of Apple Enterprise Management technologies, endpoint protection, identity management, and zero-trust network architectures (Required)
  • Advanced knowledge of Jamf products and solutions (Required)
  • Advanced knowledge of IT ecosystem and key partner integrations/complementary solutions including but not limited to Apple, Okta, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, SIEM/SOAR (Preferred)
  • Specialized expertise in minimum 2 of the following areas: endpoint security architectures, identity and access management, zero-trust network architectures, SIEM/SOAR integration, API development and automation frameworks, Infrastructure as Code, emerging technologies (AI/ML, Apple Intelligence) (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with scripting and automation languages (Go, Python, PowerShell, bash, Terraform, Ansible) and Apple developer languages (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C, Apple SDKs, Xcode) (Preferred)
  • Experience responding to RFPs and developing comprehensive solution proposals (Required)
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes for executives and decision-makers (Required)
  • Strong workshop and facilitation skills to align technical and business stakeholders (Preferred)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English (Required)
  • Comfortable engaging with a wide range of personnel, from technical to executive positions (Required)
  • Experience identifying solution gaps, ability to propose innovations, and execute subsequent implementation strategies (Preferred)
  • Active participation in the Apple enterprise community including conferences, forums, user groups, thought leadership content, or public speaking (Preferred)

 

Education and certifications

 

  • Secondary school diploma or equivalent (Required) 
  • 4 Year / Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent qualification) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Preferred) 
    • A combination of professional relevant experience and education may be considered
  • Jamf Certifications 300, 370, 400 (Preferred)
  • Relevant partner or security certifications aligned with focus area (Preferred)
  • Commitment to maintaining current certifications and pursuing emerging technology education

 

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory. 
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches. 
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to travel for customer visits, conferences, or internal events approximately 20% of the year
  • Flexible working hours may be required to accommodate regional business needs and collaboration with global teams

 

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • We’re so proud to announce we've been named in @G2's 2025 Best Software Awards for:
    🏆 Best Software for Enterprise Business
    🏆 Best Software for Mid-Market Business
    🏆 Best Software Companies

  • Jamf is a 2024 TrustRadius Tech Cares Award Winner!

  • Jamf Protect has received the honor of Endpoint Security Solution of the Year in

  • Jamf Protect received the Security Software Solution of the Year, and Jamf Threat Defense has earned the title of Mobile Security Solution of the Year, in the 2022 Computer Security Awards.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. 


What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

title: Satcom Consultant Engineer
description: Are you a highly-motivated, technically-minded, critical thinker with 3-5 years of experience in consulting, looking for your next challenge? Join a leading consulting player in the booming space industry! The Technology Consulting business line is the technology and operations’ arm of the Novaspace group. Novaspace Technology has developed expertise and know-how around a portfolio of services and capabilities covering the complete lifecycle of a space project, from feasibility studies and project development to operations and training support. We are looking for motivated consultant satcom engineers to support different consulting missions: technical studies (e.g. State of the art or innovation analysis), feasibility analysis (comparison of several high level designs) and procurement (RFP & comparative analysis of industrial proposals) of different satcom systems (LEO, MEO & GEO). If this sounds like you, then read on! Who we are looking for You have a good technical knowledge of at least one of the topics mentioned above. You like to learn and improve quickly on technical concepts and actors to grasp the technological and application challenges. You have a real team spirit, and you are rigorous. You can summarize information from a complex report to a short presentation or produce a single intelligible content from multiple sources. You are proficient in writing reports and presentations with a high level of quality. You are a good communicator, able to present content with ease in front of an audience. You are well organized, with a good level of autonomy to perform your tasks in cooperation with your leader (using collaborative and simple project management tools). Primary role and responsibilities Support (and eventually lead) the missions above mentioned which can include data collection and analysis, technical surveys of upcoming technologies and standards, support to system design analysis and generation of technical reports and presentations in accordance with project requirements. Trusted by 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace has offices strategically located in Brussels, Montreal, Munich, Paris, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington D.C. title: Staff/Senior AI Engineer, AI for Code
description:
At JetBrains, we build developer tools used by millions of engineers. The AI for Code team works on the next generation of coding agents and agentic workflows: systems that can understand codebases, plan and execute multi-step tasks, collaborate with developers, and ship reliable results inside real development environments.

We are looking for a Staff/Senior AI Engineer to join the team and support these efforts. This role is for someone who can take our internal coding models, such as Mellum2, as well as open-weight models, and turn them into production-ready coding agents for our users. You’ll work on model training and fine-tuning, context engineering, tool use, evaluation, feedback loops, and product integration. This is not research in isolation – you’ll build systems that are used by tens of thousands of developers.

What you’ll do:

  • Build production-ready coding agents and agentic workflows for real developer tasks inside JetBrains products.
  • Turn promising model capabilities into dependable product behavior through prompt design, context construction, fine-tuning, instruction-tuning, or other post-training techniques where appropriate.
  • Design and improve the agent loop itself, including tool use, execution strategy, safeguards, and task completion quality.
  • Create evaluation suites and quality infrastructure for agent behavior, including online and offline evaluations, regression checks, failure analysis, and release criteria.
  • Build feedback loops from real usage, using logs, user signals, and edge cases to improve data, evaluations, and agent behavior.
  • Work with both hosted frontier APIs and self-hosted or open-weight models, making pragmatic decisions about where each model belongs based on capability, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, ML engineers, and researchers to ship features end to end.
  • Help define the technical direction for future work, especially in ambiguous areas where we need strong judgment rather than a prewritten playbook.

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping complex systems to production.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered products, coding agents, or other AI systems.
  • Experience improving model behavior through systematic iteration, whether via prompting, context engineering, fine-tuning, preference optimization, or broader post-training methods.
  • Practical experience with evaluation and benchmarking for LLM systems, including defining task-grounded success metrics and catching regressions.
  • Experience working from noisy real-world signals rather than only from clean benchmark datasets.
  • Good judgment about trade-offs between model quality, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost.
  • Confidence working with ambiguity and taking ownership of a direction over multiple iterations.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align engineering and product decisions.

What success looks like in the first year:

  • You ship one or more agent capabilities that users can rely on for meaningful work, not just demos.
  • You establish better evaluation coverage and clearer release criteria for agent behavior.
  • You help the team build a repeatable loop from idea to shipped capability: prototype, evaluate, learn from usage, improve, and scale.

Why join us?

You’ll help define what practical, trustworthy AI for software development looks like in real products. You’ll work on challenging problems at the boundary of model capability and product reality, with the freedom to stay hands-on and the scope to influence how the next generation of JetBrains AI systems is built. 

And:

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. 
  • Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
  • Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
  • Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
  • Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
  • Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
description:
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Day to day, you will:

  • Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
  • Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
  • Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
  • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
  • Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
  • Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

What you’ll bring

  • A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
  • Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
  • The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
  • Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
  • An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
  • A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.

Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.

You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.

What you'll do

Strategy & Prioritization

  • Own your function's AI strategy, aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.
  • Map how work flows across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?
  • Manage intake of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.
  • Prioritize strategically against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.

Adoption & Change Management

  • Reimagine, not just automate. Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.
  • Drive adoption and change management together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise AI to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.
  • Build and bridge the Champion network in your function. Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.

Hands-On Building & Agent Operations

  • Build AI agents using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.
  • Author and iterate on skills files that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.
  • Configure MCP servers and tools, giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.
  • Own your function's fleet of agents. Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.
  • Expect to rebuild. AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.

What you'll bring

Business & Strategic

  • Deep knowledge of your function's operations. You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.
  • Strategic prioritization skills. You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.
  • A product management mindset. You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.
  • Strong communication and influence. You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.
  • Cross-functional instincts. You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.
  • Experience building peer networks or communities of practice. You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.

Hands-On & Technical

  • Comfortable building with AI tools. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.
  • Ready to learn fast. Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.
  • Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.
  • Ability to map data flows - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.

About the team

You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology & AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You provide the business context, prioritization, building at the no-code layer, and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI transformation.

description: About Seamflow Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files. The team Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further. The role A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them. You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week. You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. That sounds cool — what does a Customer Success Manager have to do with it? Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs in primary care and is growing fast in secondary care. The relationships that make that possible — the trust, the renewals, the accounts that stay with us even when competitors come knocking on price — are owned by our Customer Success team. We’re hiring three CSMs to grow the team across both primary and secondary care. You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise NHS accounts end-to-end, from implementation through to renewal. In primary care, it’s about protecting and deepening relationships that are already strong. In secondary care, it’s about building them from scratch in a market where Accurx Scribe is winning big and growing fast. Either way, it’s about being the person NHS organisations trust — the one who knows their priorities, anticipates problems before they arise, and makes Accurx genuinely indispensable. The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Manager Own your NHS accounts end-to-end. You’ll manage a portfolio of 5–11 ICB or Trust enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, leading renewals, and keeping Accurx sticky even when the NHS is in flux. You’re the person your customers call first. Build trust where Accurx is new. In secondary care, we’re expanding quickly into a more complex environment. You’ll help NHS Trusts get real outcomes from Accurx Scribe — building processes that don’t yet exist and earning the kind of trust we’ve spent years building in primary care. Be a connector, not just an account manager. You’ll work across marketing, implementation, transformation, commercial ops, and finance. The best CSMs here don’t just manage accounts — they bring the voice of the customer back into the business and make things better for the whole team. Build the playbook as you go. The team is scaling and many of our processes are still being written. You’ll contribute to and shape how account management works at Accurx. What works gets codified; what doesn’t gets challenged. Navigate the NHS with patience and precision. NHS organisations are under enormous pressure — restructuring, funding uncertainty, stakeholder churn. You’ll hold relationships through difficult periods and keep Accurx front of mind even when it’s not their immediate priority. You should apply if... You own relationships, not just accounts. You’ve worked in customer success, account management, or a relationship-heavy role and you know the difference between being a yes-person and being a trusted advisor. Accurx has no commission plan — success here is measured by trust, retention, and real outcomes. You push back constructively. You don’t jump when a customer says jump. You ask why — more than once — and you find a better solution. You’re empathetic but not a pushover. You’re comfortable building from scratch. Processes aren’t fully defined here. You’d rather create structure than wait for someone else to do it, and you’re okay if the first version isn’t perfect. You’re curious about the NHS. Whether you’ve worked in or around it or you’re coming in fresh — you’re genuinely interested in how it works and patient enough to navigate its complexity. You’re AI-native. You use AI tools to work smarter — automating the routine so you can spend more time on the things that actually need you. You’re a natural connector. You’re as comfortable in a room with a clinical lead as you are with a Trust’s Head of Digital Transformation or a commercial director. You adapt your style and bring people with you. What’s in it for me? You’ll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we’re led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity. £50,000 – £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000 Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life Flexible Working: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am–4pm Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat! Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub . Find us across social media: Medium , LinkedIn , X , Instagram and YouTube . Diversity and Equal Opportunities: We are an equal opportunities employer and a pleasant and supportive place to work. We particularly welcome applications from those who are significantly underrepresented in the technology sector, such as women, non-binary people, transgender people, people with disabilities, LGBTQIA+ community and individuals from Black and Minority Ethnic communities. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

That sounds cool — what does a Customer Success Manager have to do with it?

Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs in primary care and is growing fast in secondary care. The relationships that make that possible — the trust, the renewals, the accounts that stay with us even when competitors come knocking on price — are owned by our Customer Success team.

We’re hiring three CSMs to grow the team across both primary and secondary care. You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise NHS accounts end-to-end, from implementation through to renewal. In primary care, it’s about protecting and deepening relationships that are already strong. In secondary care, it’s about building them from scratch in a market where Accurx Scribe is winning big and growing fast. Either way, it’s about being the person NHS organisations trust — the one who knows their priorities, anticipates problems before they arise, and makes Accurx genuinely indispensable.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Manager

  • Own your NHS accounts end-to-end. You’ll manage a portfolio of 5–11 ICB or Trust enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, leading renewals, and keeping Accurx sticky even when the NHS is in flux. You’re the person your customers call first.

  • Build trust where Accurx is new. In secondary care, we’re expanding quickly into a more complex environment. You’ll help NHS Trusts get real outcomes from Accurx Scribe — building processes that don’t yet exist and earning the kind of trust we’ve spent years building in primary care.

  • Be a connector, not just an account manager. You’ll work across marketing, implementation, transformation, commercial ops, and finance. The best CSMs here don’t just manage accounts — they bring the voice of the customer back into the business and make things better for the whole team.

  • Build the playbook as you go. The team is scaling and many of our processes are still being written. You’ll contribute to and shape how account management works at Accurx. What works gets codified; what doesn’t gets challenged.

  • Navigate the NHS with patience and precision. NHS organisations are under enormous pressure — restructuring, funding uncertainty, stakeholder churn. You’ll hold relationships through difficult periods and keep Accurx front of mind even when it’s not their immediate priority.

You should apply if...

  • You own relationships, not just accounts. You’ve worked in customer success, account management, or a relationship-heavy role and you know the difference between being a yes-person and being a trusted advisor. Accurx has no commission plan — success here is measured by trust, retention, and real outcomes.

  • You push back constructively. You don’t jump when a customer says jump. You ask why — more than once — and you find a better solution. You’re empathetic but not a pushover.

  • You’re comfortable building from scratch. Processes aren’t fully defined here. You’d rather create structure than wait for someone else to do it, and you’re okay if the first version isn’t perfect.

  • You’re curious about the NHS. Whether you’ve worked in or around it or you’re coming in fresh — you’re genuinely interested in how it works and patient enough to navigate its complexity.

  • You’re AI-native. You use AI tools to work smarter — automating the routine so you can spend more time on the things that actually need you.

  • You’re a natural connector. You’re as comfortable in a room with a clinical lead as you are with a Trust’s Head of Digital Transformation or a commercial director. You adapt your style and bring people with you.

What’s in it for me?

You’ll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we’re led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

  • £50,000 – £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible Working: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am–4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

·       UK Pension Scheme

·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

  • Facilitate workshops that turn stakeholder skepticism into a tangible blueprint and path to value.

Value engineering (business case support)

  • Build a credible value narrative: labor productivity gains, cycle time reduction, compliance/control improvements, and stack simplification.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and another major European language, preferably German, depending on territory.

 

What you'll get

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

title: Senior Partner Growth Manager
description:
About Us

We are Ocado Commercial, and we are revolutionising online grocery. We partner with the world's leading retailers, providing our innovative Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) – a powerful blend of automation and software – to elevate their e-commerce capabilities. Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future of retail, working with global giants from Kroger to AEON. 

About the Role

The Senior Partner Growth Manager role is an exciting opportunity in our Partner Success Team to directly influence the commercial success of our partners, some of the largest retailers in EMEA. This position will require reasonable travel to Saudi Arabia and/or Europe. 

Businesses that partner with Ocado come in all shapes and sizes, and leverage our technology in different ways.  In this role, you will combine your knowledge of ecommerce, grocery retail, and online marketing with communication skills and analytical abilities to shape and influence how our partners grow online. 

The Partner Growth Manager will work with the Ocado Partner Account team to drive the growth agenda in our partner’s business, enabling our partners to improve commercial outcomes, grow their customer base, order volume, and overall profitability. 

You will build effective relationships with key commercial, marketing, and ecommerce stakeholders in our partners’ businesses. You will leverage knowledge of customer objectives, strategic know-how, knowledge of the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP), as well as the expertise of our central growth subject matter experts to create and implement successful growth strategies. You will become a first line of e-commerce growth support, leveraging our team of central subject matter experts for more in-depth support. You will support your internal stakeholders in the region with insights and reporting on growth topics, as well as be a source of information and support for your partners. 

As part of the Partner Success Team you will be responsible for supporting our partners in their day to day use of OSP, ensuring that their webshop is configured optimally, using the most impactful OSP features, to drive maximum customer acquisition, retention and basket size.

You will consult with partners through both in-depth projects in close collaboration with our Central Growth and/or Technology teams, as well as ongoing optimisation forums aimed at improving their commercial performance. You will leverage data to drive recommendations that improve overall performance. 

  • The Partner Growth Manager is accountable for shaping and delivering growth strategy for their assigned Partner(s), supporting improved commercial outcomes including customer acquisition, retention, order growth and profitability.
  • Works closely with the Partner’s ecommerce, marketing and technology teams and cross-functional Ocado stakeholders to align growth priorities and execution.
  • Uses growth, trading and customer data and analytics to understand commercial performance, identify trends and opportunities, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations to Partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Accountable for translating Partner growth objectives into clear, prioritised growth initiatives and optimisation opportunities that support long-term commercial success, maximising the potential of the OSP platform.
  • Acts as Ocado’s primary growth and ecommerce subject matter expert for the Partner, using deep knowledge of OSP capabilities and growth / go-to-market expertise to shape recommendations on ecommerce configuration, trading, monetisation and customer experience, as well as sustainable marketing and communications adapted to the local competitive landscape
  • Owns the Partner relationship for e-commerce and growth OSP roadmap engagement, acting as the named point of contact for, trading, monetisation, customer experience roadmap topic, and, in general, any non-operational topic.
  • Represents Partner growth and ecommerce requirements and priorities into Ocado’s roadmap governance processes, supporting feature discovery with clear problem definition, context and Partner business case and value articulation.
  • Monitors delivery and adoption of growth-critical features and capabilities, working with internal teams and Partners to maximise realised commercial value and improve utilisation of growth-enabling functionality.
  • Identifies and escalates risks, dependencies or delivery issues that may impact the Partner’s ability to realise growth from OSP capabilities.

About you

  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential. Arabic and European languages are highly desirable.
  • Bias to action, capable of designing data-driven strategies but also secure implementation
  • Stakeholder, relationship building and networking skills
  • A team player who’s comfortable interacting with Partner teams
  • Self-motivated with an ability to deliver to deadlines and multi-task under pressure
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty
  • Able to handle difficult situations, facing challenges with positivity, confidence and pragmatism
  • Experience in one or several of the following fields:
    • Performance marketing within a direct to consumer business (grocery ecommerce experience a plus)
    • Commercial or trading experience in a direct to consumer business ( grocery ecommerce experience a plus)
    • Retail management consulting 
  • Familiarity and passion for data-driven marketing, consumer insight, and ecommerce
  • Familiarity with or experience with measuring and optimizing key growth metrics including user growth, conversion, LTV

What we offer

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge:
    25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
  • Health & wellbeing:
    Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
  • Family-first policies:
    22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave
  • Financial support:
    Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.
  • Commuter perks:
    Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
  • Exclusive discounts:
    15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).

Ocado Group is an equal opportunities employer and as such makes every effort to ensure that all potential employees are treated fairly and equally, regardless of their sex, sexual orientation, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, age, or disability or union membership status.

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology service. We combine data, technology, creative content, and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like ad campaigns, augmented reality, and chatbots. Our clients include ASOS, Just Eat Takeaway, Twitch, TikTok, and The White Company. 

Here at DEPT®, we are proud of the award winning, creative campaigns and content that we produce for a range of exciting and well known brands, and we believe that our Media Team is pivotal in the success of those campaigns. Our Media Team is made up of both paid and organic media specialists and we are looking for a new SEA Specialist to join the team to service an exciting new client.

You are a critical thinker and analytical problem solver, equally curious and creative. You have a strong command of paid search platforms, such as Google Ads and Bing Ads, and can effectively communicate complex ideas to clients and internal stakeholders. You have a track record of driving results and optimizing campaigns to meet client objectives. As a key member of the team, you will contribute to the growth and success of our clients' digital campaigns.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage multi-market paid search and shopping campaigns for clients;
  • Conduct keyword research and analysis to identify relevant search terms and opportunities for campaign optimisation;
  • Lean into automation and use of data within campaigns, including utilising AI to improve performance;
  • Create and optimize paid search campaigns across various platforms, such as Google Ads and Bing Ads;
  • Monitor campaign performance, analyse data, and provide regular reports to clients, highlighting key metrics and recommendations for improvement;
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in paid search advertising;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution of campaigns and alignment with client goals;
  • Stay informed about changes in search engine algorithms and adjust strategies accordingly;
  • Carry out technical analysis, content & authority analysis;
  • Set up implementation plans and workflows;
  • Respond to client (internal and external) briefs;
  • Report on activity on weekly, monthly and quarterly basis;
  • Have a direct client communication.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Prior experience managing and optimising paid search & shopping campaigns, preferably within a digital agency or similar environment;
  • Strong knowledge of paid search platforms, such as Google Ads and Bing Ads;
  • Experience with client communication;
  • Excellent analytical skills and ability to interpret data to drive campaign optimisation;
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment;
  • Intermediate or higher proficiency in the use of Excel/Sheets and familiarity with Word/Docs and PowerPoint/Slides;
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills with a high attention to detail;
  • Ability to react quickly within a fast-paced environment;
  • Directly available to start working from either our Manchester or London office;
  • Full working proficiency in the English language;

WE OFFER

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy (2 days from the office, depending on location);
  • An excellent salary based on experience and equal pay policies;
  • Pension, free private healthcare, mental health support, and company sick pay scheme;
  • 26 days paid holiday (plus UK Bank Holidays);
  • Refreshments are provided in the office all week, as well as drinks at 4 pm on a Thursday;
  • Help getting you to work with a season ticket loan and cycle to work scheme;
  • Enhanced family friendly policies to support new parents;
  • Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations;
  • Inspirational Talks, bringing the outside in with regular guest speakers and events;
  • Learning and Development, supporting your growth with continuous opportunities to learn and advance;
  • Buddy Programme: You will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you through your first weeks’ at DEPT®;
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards;
  • Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with big names and clients.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION 

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

title: Senior Research Consultant DACH (B2B Focus) (m/f/d)
description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here

Your mission as a Senior Research Consultant

We are looking for a Senior Research Consultant (m/f/d) with a strong quantitative market research background to join our newly dedicated B2B research team in the DACH region. This specialized unit focuses on research projects that specifically survey B2B target groups, professional decision-makers, and niche business audiences (rather than only only standard B2C consumer panels), serving fast-moving consultancy clients and corporate B2B requests.

In this role, you will lead complex quantitative B2B research projects end-to-end, from initial feasibility alignment and study design to reporting and insight presentation. You will act as a senior sparring partner for corporate strategy leads and consultancy teams, translating intricate B2B & B2C data into clear, decision-ready recommendations. You will thrive in a high-velocity environment where speed, rigorous B2B screening logic, strong client presence, and operational precision are essential.

What you’ll be doing

  • End-to-End B2B Project Lead: Manage quantitative research projects end-to-end, including B2B screening design, questionnaire drafting, platform setup, fieldwork monitoring, and data delivery.
  • Methodology & Study Design: Optimise bespoke study designs across core use cases (e.g., Target Group Analysis, U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing) mainly tailored to hard-to-reach professional audiences.
  • Senior Client Sparring & Advisory: Act as a trusted partner for fast-paced consultancy and corporate clients, advising on sample feasibility, survey logic, and optimal research approaches under tight deadlines.
  • Commercial & Scoping Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales and Account Management on project scoping, feasibility checks, and methodology definition for complex project requests.
  • Process & Quality Enhancement: Contribute to standardizing B2B screening protocols, sampling frameworks, and best practices to coach other researcher and safeguard delivery speed and research quality across the team.

You will thrive in this role if

  • You have 5+ years of experience in quantitative market research with a distinct focus on surveying B2B target groups and professional decision-makers (agency or consulting background required; pure academic or non-client backgrounds will not fit this role).
  • You have hands-on experience designing studies, writing questionnaires, and executing quantitative projects across core B2B use cases (e.g., U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing, Target Group Analysis).
  • You bring proven experience creating executive-ready reports and presenting complex data through clear, compelling storytelling to senior client-side stakeholders.
  • You possess a strategic, commercially minded approach with the self-confidence to guide clients and defend research decisions under pressure.
  • You excel in high-velocity environments, with a demonstrated ability to juggle multiple concurrent projects, prioritize effectively, and stay calm under tight deadlines.
  • You are proficient in German (C2 level required) and English, with outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • You bring a pragmatic, proactive, and resilient mindset with a passion for data quality and innovation.

What’s in it for you?

  • Flexibility Policy - Our flexibility policy means there is no hard cap on the number of vacation days you can take
  • Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year
  • All the hardware you need and your own MacBook
  • If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space
  • Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location
  • In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces

Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm.

Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

  • Change Management: Design and implement effective change management strategies to ensure the smooth adoption of new processes, tools, and team structures for both the client and our internal teams.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with client transitions, developing contingency plans to ensure a smooth and professional onboarding experience.
  • Team Leadership: Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing transition team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and accountability. Leadership in a matrix environment.

  • An extensive and proven track record in a senior transition, programme management, or project management role, gained within a large-scale media agency, consultancy, or other complex, global organization.

  • Deep expertise in applying project, programme, and change management methodologies (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) to deliver successful business outcomes.
  • Exceptional senior stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven ability to influence and build consensus with executive-level leaders.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing complex project budgets and ensuring profitability.
  • Inspirational leadership skills with experience building and developing high-performing teams.
  • A strategic and commercially-minded approach, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and solve complex problems with clarity and confidence.
  • Familiarity with leveraging AI tools and AI-powered support for project management and project management tracking.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Significant prior experience within an agency group active in multi-market environments.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

Role Summary and Impact 

At Code, we design and build digital products and platforms for a range of clients.

We’re looking for a Front-end Engineer with strong browser-side engineering skills who cares about how interfaces work in practice.

You’ll work mainly in TypeScript and React, building responsive, accessible and performant interfaces as part of a multidisciplinary product team. We use application frameworks including React Router and Next.js, but strong foundations in HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter just as much.

This is a senior engineering role, so you’ll do more than implement designs. You’ll help shape how interfaces are built, work closely with designers on interaction and behaviour, contribute to technical decisions, and help other engineers improve their front-end skills.

You’ll also contribute to how we approach front-end engineering across Code, sharing what works and challenging approaches when there’s a better way to do things.

Skills and Experience 

  • Build high-quality user interfaces using TypeScript, React, HTML and CSS.
  • Work with React Router, Next.js and similar React application frameworks.
  • Work closely with designers to turn ideas and designs into usable, responsive interfaces rather than simply reproducing static screens.
  • Make accessibility part of the way software is designed and built, not something added at the end.
  • Pay close attention to browser performance, loading behaviour and the experience across different devices and connection speeds.
  • Help shape component architecture and contribute to reusable design systems and shared patterns.
  • Write automated tests at the right level, from component and interaction tests through to browser-based end-to-end testing.
  • Review code, talk through approaches and help less experienced engineers develop their skills.
  • Work alongside other engineers to understand APIs, application behaviour and how the front end fits into the wider platform.
  • Contribute to the front-end engineering community at Code, sharing ideas and helping us improve how we build for the web.
  • Highly competent across core front-end skillsets: HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (Vanilla) etc. 

You’ll have good experience building production web applications and strong browser fundamentals.

HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter to us. You should understand how browsers work and be able to build interfaces that are responsive, accessible and robust without relying on a framework to solve everything.

You’ll also need solid TypeScript and React experience, with experience working in applications built with React Router, Next.js or similar approaches.

Accessibility should be familiar territory. You should understand semantic HTML, keyboard interaction, focus management and the practical application of WCAG when building interfaces. You should also have experience testing interfaces with screen readers and understand how common interaction patterns are experienced by people using assistive technology.

Performance matters too. You should be able to investigate and improve things such as loading, rendering, JavaScript execution, images and Core Web Vitals.

You’ll need experience with automated testing. The exact tools are less important than knowing what to test and why, but you may have worked with tools such as Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress.

Working well with designers is important. That means understanding the intent behind a design, talking through interaction and responsive behaviour, spotting problems and contributing to the solution rather than waiting for every detail to be specified.

Experience with design systems, Storybook, design tokens or shared component libraries is useful, particularly if you’ve helped establish patterns rather than simply consumed them.

As a senior engineer, you’ll also be expected to support others. You don’t need to have formally managed people, but you should be able to review work, share what you know and help other engineers develop.

We don’t expect you to match every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong front-end fundamentals, good engineering judgement and a genuine interest in building accessible, well-crafted web interfaces.

About WPP 650

Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.

Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You'll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It's demanding - but always rewarding.

This is meaningful work with real-world impact - the kind you can point to with pride.

The advertising industry is in the midst of the biggest multi-generational communications shift in history. CMOs and public sector leaders are mastering two critical transformations: delivering a data, technology & AI-powered future, and moving beyond paid advertising. Organizations must shift from interrupting people with ads to engaging people with highly relevant, trust-building experiences.

WPP Media is establishing The Experience Capability, a transformational offering that sits at the heart of integrated ESOP (Earned, Shared, Owned, Paid) strategies. This capability creates and integrates experiences across Platforms, Applied Innovation, DCO, Creators, and Creative Excellence to unlock growth for our clients' most pressing business challenges.

We are seeking a Business Director (BD), Innovation to serve as the key strategic and operational driver for our flagship UK Government account (WPP 650). Reporting directly to the VP, Innovation, this role is instrumental in developing breakthrough innovation strategies, designing cutting-edge thought-leadership frameworks, and translating complex technology/media trends into actionable public-sector campaigns.

You will work closely with multi-disciplinary planners and strategists across the entire WPP 650 team. Crucially, you will act as a key collaborative bridge—partnering with Citizen Consultancy and Behavioural Science specialists to ground creative technology in deep audience understanding, integrating DE&I frameworks to ensure innovations are accessible and representative, operationalising the implementation of innovation with Activation, Data, Tech & Analysis teams, and coordinating with dedicated Hub teams to turn strategies into high-impact public service campaigns.
